name: wispcrew-cli
description: How to drive WispCrew from its command line: agents, conversations, routines, approvals, paired machines, setup and troubleshooting.
body:
# The wispcrew command line

You are running inside WispCrew, and `wispcrew` is its command line. It
speaks to the same engine the desktop app uses, over the same protocol, so
anything you do here shows up in the app immediately and the reverse.

Run it with your shell tool.

## Worth knowing without looking anything up

```
wispcrew agents                 # what lives on this machine
wispcrew ask <agent> "..."      # send a message, wait for the reply
wispcrew status                 # is the engine up, and on which profile
wispcrew capabilities --json    # the entire surface, for a program
```

## Two things that will bite you

**`--json` works on almost everything.** Parse that, never the table — the
columns are meant for people and are free to change; the JSON is not.

**Every command needs a running engine.** Without one you get "No WispCrew
daemon is running for this profile". Start it with `wispcrew serve`, and add
`--listen` if anything other than this machine needs to reach it.

## Do not guess a flag

There are 50 commands, grouped below. Read the section that
covers what you are doing, or run `wispcrew <command> --help`. An invented
flag usually fails loudly; an invented VALUE quietly does the wrong thing.

sections.name: agents
sections.description: Create, inspect, configure and remove agents; their model and workspace.
sections.body:
# wispcrew — agents

Create, inspect, configure and remove agents; their model and workspace.

### `wispcrew agents`

List the agents on this machine.

Returns: array of { id, name, model, node, approvalPolicy }

### `wispcrew agents show`

Everything about one agent.

- `agent` — name or id

Returns: object

### `wispcrew agents create`

Create an agent on THIS machine, with its own room.

- `name`
- `--description`
- `--model`
- `--policy` — ask | auto | readonly

Returns: the created agent

### `wispcrew agents delete`

Remove an agent and its conversation.

- `agent`
- `--yes` — destructive; required in scripts

Returns: { ok, deleted, name }

### `wispcrew agents set`

Change an agent: model, permissions, description, workspace.

- `agent`
- `--model`
- `--policy` — ask | auto | readonly
- `--description`
- `--workspace`
- `--name`

Returns: the updated agent

### `wispcrew agents duplicate`

Copy an agent’s configuration under a new name.

- `agent`

Returns: the new agent

### `wispcrew agents stop`

Interrupt whatever an agent is doing.

- `agent`

Returns: { ok, agent }

sections.name: talking
sections.description: Send a message and read the reply; transcripts, rewind, branch, history.
sections.body:
# wispcrew — talking

Send a message and read the reply; transcripts, rewind, branch, history.

### `wispcrew ask`

Send a message and wait for the reply. Blocks.

- `agent`
- `message`
- `--timeout` — seconds; default 180

Returns: { agent, answer, errors, timedOut }

### `wispcrew rooms`

List conversations and who is in them.

Returns: array of { id, title, mode, agents }

### `wispcrew rooms show`

One conversation: who is in it, and how much has been said.

- `room` — title or id

Returns: the room, plus an entry count

### `wispcrew rooms tail`

The last part of a conversation.

- `room`
- `--lines` — default 20

Returns: array of transcript entries

### `wispcrew rooms add`

Put an agent in a room, so it can be addressed there.

- `room`
- `agent`

Returns: { ok, room, agent }

### `wispcrew rooms remove`

Take an agent out of a room.

- `room`
- `agent`

Returns: { ok, room, agent }

### `wispcrew rooms clear`

Empty a conversation.

- `room`
- `--yes` — destructive; required in scripts

Returns: { ok, room }

### `wispcrew rooms mode`

How much the room constrains who speaks.

- `room`
- `mode` — directed | open | free

Returns: { ok, room, mode }

### `wispcrew rooms rewind`

Drop everything after an entry.

- `room`
- `entry` — id from rooms tail --json

Returns: { ok, room, to }

### `wispcrew rooms branch`

Fork a conversation into a new agent from a chosen point.

- `room`
- `entry`
- `--name`

Returns: the new agent

### `wispcrew history`

Earlier versions of a conversation, kept before anything was removed.

- `room`

Returns: array of saved versions

### `wispcrew history restore`

Put a conversation back to an earlier version.

- `room`
- `id` — a prefix is enough

Returns: { ok, room, version }

sections.name: automation
sections.description: Cron routines, file watches, self-scheduled follow-ups and their runs.
sections.body:
# wispcrew — automation

Cron routines, file watches, self-scheduled follow-ups and their runs.

### `wispcrew tasks`

List turns, past and present.

Returns: array of { id, agent, state, startedAt, finishedAt, detail }

### `wispcrew tasks status`

The state of one task.

- `id` — a prefix is enough

Returns: the task

### `wispcrew tasks wait`

Block until a task settles.

- `id`
- `--timeout` — seconds; default 600

Returns: the task

### `wispcrew tasks cancel`

Stop an unfinished task.

- `id`

Returns: { ok, id }

### `wispcrew routines`

Scheduled work: what runs, for whom, and when.

Returns: array of routines

### `wispcrew routines create`

Schedule a prompt to run on its own.

- `agent`
- `cron` — five fields, e.g. "0 9 * * *"
- `prompt`
- `--name`
- `--paused` — create it inactive

Returns: the created routine

### `wispcrew routines run`

Run a routine now, without waiting for its schedule.

- `routine`

Returns: { ok, id, name }

### `wispcrew routines pause`

Stop a routine firing, without deleting it.

- `routine`

Returns: { ok, id, enabled }

### `wispcrew routines resume`

Let a paused routine fire again.

- `routine`

Returns: { ok, id, enabled }

### `wispcrew routines delete`

Remove a routine.

- `routine`
- `--yes` — destructive; required in scripts

Returns: { ok, deleted }

sections.name: approvals
sections.description: Answering a tool that needs permission, and standing grants.
sections.body:
# wispcrew — approvals

Answering a tool that needs permission, and standing grants.

### `wispcrew approvals`

What is waiting for permission to run.

Returns: array of { id, agentId, agentName, tool, summary, createdAt, expiresAt }

### `wispcrew approvals allow`

Permit one pending tool call.

- `id` — a prefix is enough

Returns: { ok, id, allowed }

### `wispcrew approvals deny`

Refuse one pending tool call.

- `id`

Returns: { ok, id, allowed }

### `wispcrew grants`

Standing permissions — tools an agent may use without asking.

Returns: array of { agentId, tool }

### `wispcrew grants revoke`

Take back a standing permission, so the agent asks again.

- `agent`
- `tool`
- `--all` — revoke every grant

Returns: { ok, agent, tool } or { ok, revoked }

sections.name: machines
sections.description: Pairing another machine, listing nodes, and serving this engine.
sections.body:
# wispcrew — machines

Pairing another machine, listing nodes, and serving this engine.

### `wispcrew pair`

Attach another machine, using a code it printed.

- `address` — host or host:port
- `code` — single-use, expires
- `--fingerprint` — what the other machine printed; checked before trusting it
- `--yes` — pair without checking a fingerprint

Returns: { ok, id, name, address, fingerprint }

sections.name: setup
sections.description: Providers, models, keys, Telegram, skills and MCP plugins.
sections.body:
# wispcrew — setup

Providers, models, keys, Telegram, skills and MCP plugins.

### `wispcrew mcp`

Model Context Protocol servers, and whether they connected.

Returns: array of servers

### `wispcrew mcp add`

Register an MCP server, extending every agent’s tools.

- `name`
- `command`
- `args` — remaining words

Returns: the server

### `wispcrew mcp remove`

Unregister an MCP server.

- `name`
- `--yes`

Returns: { ok, removed }

### `wispcrew providers`

Provider presets this build knows about.

Returns: array of { id, label, defaultModel }

### `wispcrew personas`

Built-in agent personas.

Returns: array of { id, description }

### `wispcrew signins`

Subscription sign-ins and whether they are still valid.

Returns: array of { vendor, signedIn, detail }

### `wispcrew signout`

Forget a subscription sign-in.

- `vendor` — claude | chatgpt

Returns: { ok, vendor }

### `wispcrew skills`

Reusable instruction sets, invoked in a message with /name.

Returns: array of skills

### `wispcrew machines`

Other machines paired with this one.

Returns: array of { id, name, address, fingerprint }

### `wispcrew machines forget`

Drop a paired machine and delete its token here.

- `machine` — name or id

Returns: { ok, forgotten, name }

### `wispcrew configure`

Set the provider, model and key for THIS machine.

- `--provider`
- `--model`
- `--key` — stored encrypted; never leaves this node

Returns: { ok, settings }

### `wispcrew settings`

The current provider settings.

Returns: object; the key itself is never returned

sections.name: troubleshooting
sections.description: When something is not answering: status, logs, and testing a provider.
sections.body:
# wispcrew — troubleshooting

When something is not answering: status, logs, and testing a provider.

### `wispcrew test provider`

Check the configured provider actually answers.

Returns: { ok, error? }

### `wispcrew test telegram`

Send a test message through Telegram.

Returns: { ok, error? }

### `wispcrew capabilities`

This description, as data.

Returns: object
